labFull: Nano Materials Electrochemical Energy Design Laboratory
affiliation: Chung-Ang University · School of Integrative Engineering
introEn: We develop synthetic routes for a wide range of novel nanomaterials and apply them to electrochemical energy technologies — fuel cells, water electrolysis and batteries.
Through thin-film processing and X-ray characterization of the materials we synthesize, we work to push the performance of these devices further.
